Hello ! Probation Period & Compensation

To ensure we are a good fit for one another, all new Virtual Assistants will begin with a one-week paid probation period. This gives both you and the company the opportunity to determine whether this position is the right fit.

Week 1 – Probation
Pay: $60 per week
Schedule: Up to 6 hours per day, 6 days per week

During your probation week, your performance will be evaluated based on:

Accuracy and attention to detail
Communication and responsiveness
Ability to follow instructions
Reliability and consistency
Professionalism and work ethic
After Successful Probation

If you successfully complete the probation period, your weekly pay will increase to:

$90 per week
Up to 6 hours per day, 6 days per week
Performance Reviews & Pay Increases

After working with us for 2 weeks to 1 month, we will conduct a performance review.

If your work is consistently completed with accuracy, precision, strong communication, reliability, and a positive work ethic, you may receive a $30 or more weekly pay increase, bringing your weekly pay from $90 to at least $120 per week.

Future raises are also available as you continue to grow with the company. Pay increases are based on factors such as:

Completing tasks accurately with minimal errors
Following instructions precisely
Meeting deadlines consistently
Excellent communication
Taking initiative and solving problems independently
Dependability and professionalism
Contributing ideas that help improve the business

Our goal is to build a long-term team where dedicated Virtual Assistants are rewarded for consistent, high-quality performance. As your responsibilities and contributions grow, your compensation can continue to grow as well.
